items.title: freeze_git archive plumbing: tag name, bytes-fed mktree, commit-tree, reachability
items.action: In plugins/harness/lib/harness_lib/freeze_git.py add, beside the name builders and with the module docstring updated: archive_tag(stem, round, m=1) -> archive/<stem>/r<N> or archive/<stem>/r<N>-<m> (as base_tag does for m); mktree(repo, entries: Mapping[str, str]) -> tree sha: a tree whose entries are the named subtrees (mode 040000), built by git mktree -z with stdin given as bytes (a _run_bytes helper beside _run: subprocess.run with input=bytes, no text mode), entries joined with NUL and sorted by name, so text-mode newline translation on Windows can never add \r to a name; an empty mapping gives the empty tree; commit_tree(repo, tree, parents, message) -> commit sha via git commit-tree with one -p per distinct parent in first-seen order and the message on stdin (-F -); archive_tips(repo, stem) -> the commits archive/<stem>/r<N>[-<m>] tags peel to, ordered by m (the plain name first), other stems never; reaches(repo, tips, obj) -> True when obj is a commit and an ancestor of (or equal to) any tip (merge-base --is-ancestor; a tree or a missing object gives False); tree_held(repo, tips, tree) -> True when tree is any subtree listed by git ls-tree -r -d -z of a tip; delete_tags(repo, names) -> git tag -d of the names (no call for none). Every git call keeps -C repo; FreezeGitError on a failing step. Copy the planned test file to tests/lib/test_freeze_git_archive.py first.

items.title: plan.py archive: fold a plan's driver tags into archive/<stem>/r1 and delete them
items.action: New plugins/harness/lib/harness_lib/plan_archive.py (module docstring, functions under 50 lines) and an archive subcommand in plugins/harness/scripts/plan.py. driver_tags(repo, stem): {name: peeled object} of every tag under <stem>/ whose first segment is base, receipt or a freeze_ledger.EntryKind value (freeze, lock, unlock, arm, reopen, relink), archive/ tags never: relink, arm and unlock entries carry <kind>/<stem>/r1.<k>-commit tags (plan_lock._entry_stem), and they fold like the rest. The fold: a receipt/<stem>/<ITEM>-tree[.n] tag puts its tree at receipts/<ITEM>[.n]; a receipt -commit[.n] tag puts the commit's tree at receipts/<ITEM>[.n] (receipts/<ITEM>-commit[.n] when a -tree tag already took that name) and the commit among the parents; freeze/ and lock/ <stem>/r1.<k>-tree put the tree at freezes/r1.<k>; every <kind>/<stem>/r1.<k>-commit[.n] tag of any entry kind and every base tag (r1 and r1-<m>) add the commit to the parents. Re-archive (D1): when fg.archive_tips(repo, stem) is not empty, the new name is fg.archive_tag(stem, 1, m) with m one past the highest existing (the plain name counts as 1) and the last tip is the first parent. Message: 'Archive of <stem>: every base, receipt and ledger entry object', a blank line, then one '<tag name> <sha40>' line per folded tag sorted by name (plus 'previous: <archive tag> <sha40>' on a re-archive). Build with fg.mktree (receipts and freezes subtrees, then the root holding whichever are non-empty) and fg.commit_tree inside plan_lock's identity fallback (rename plan_lock._tagger to tagger, its uses at :230 and :263 follow; S3). Before any tag is created, verify through the module attributes fg.reaches (each folded commit) and fg.tree_held (each folded tree) with the new commit as the only tip; each miss is a problem '<name> (<sha7>) is not reachable from the archive; nothing tagged or deleted' and the command refuses (PlanError). Then preflight and create the archive tag (pk.preflight, fg.ensure_tag, annotated, message '<stem>: archive of round 1'), then fg.delete_tags on the folded names. Output: 'archive [done] | plan <id> | <archive tag> -> <sha7> | folded <n> tag(s)', 'tag: <archive tag> -> <sha7>', 'push: git push origin <archive tag>', 'deleted: <folded names sorted, space-joined>', and with --remote 'remote: git push origin --delete <folded names but receipt/ ones, sorted>' (no line when none is left). No driver tags: problem 'plan <id> has no driver tags to archive'. The command runs no reconcile. plan.py: cmd_archive, an archive parser in _lock_parsers (help: fold the plan's driver tags into one archive tag, on the developer's explicit ask; --remote: also print the remote delete line), COMMANDS entry, and an archive PLAN [--remote] section in the module docstring that also states the check change of TASK-3. Copy the planned test file to its repo path first.

items.title: Reconcile and check count an archived plan's objects as tagged
items.action: In plugins/harness/lib/harness_lib/plan_lock.py, with tips = fg.archive_tips(repo, stem) and folded = fg.archived_names(repo, tips) read once per call (archived_names, new in plugins/harness/lib/harness_lib/freeze_git.py: the set of tag names the '<name> <sha40>' lines of the tips' commit messages list; empty for no tips): reconcile drops each row whose entry has a '<entry stem>-commit' or '-commit.<n>' name in folded, so an entry an archive folded gets no new -commit tag, even after a rebase moved the commit that added its file, while an entry written after the archive (a refreeze, relink, arm or unlock) is tagged as before and folds into r1-<m> (D1); base_held is also True when an archive reaches the base (fg.reaches), so a refreeze after the archive tags no base; _base_lines prints off-history whenever the base is off HEAD's history, archived or not (the relink cue), and untagged only when no base tag peels to it and no archive reaches it; _entry_lines prints a tree line only when no tree tag holds the entry's tree and no archive tree holds it (fg.tree_held), and the commit line only when the entry has no -commit name in folded (the archive keeps that entry's commit as a parent).
